name: letak-worker-coopjednota
description: Detects new COOP Jednota Slovensko leaflets on coop.sk/letaky (nationwide Potraviny/Supermarket/Tempo, Tempo, regional) and returns their metadata + PDF URLs (no downloads).
author: sim0n92

execute.description: Fetch coop.sk/letaky (JSON-LD list), resolve each new leaflet's PDF through its Adobe InDesign viewer, and return the leaflets not present in knownLeaflets. A list without leaflets (NO_LEAFLETS) or a leaflet without PDF (PDF_NOT_FOUND) is an error.

outputPath.description: Absolute path where the result JSON document must be written.

knownLeaflets.description: Leaflet keys already known to the caller, each formatted as 'type|from|to|id' (id = the leaflet page slug, e.g. 'tempo-43-2026'). NOTE: unlike other chains' 3-part 'type|from|to' key, coopjednota uses a 4-part key because its federated regional co-ops can publish multiple distinct leaflets under the same banner and date range at once - the 'id' disambiguates them.

types.description: Case-insensitive banner filter: 'CoopPotraviny' (the nationwide Potraviny, Supermarket a Tempo leaflet), 'Tempo', 'Regional'. Empty means all.

pageUrl.description: Override for the leaflet list URL. Defaults to https://www.coop.sk/letaky

id.description: Slug of the leaflet's page on coop.sk (e.g. 'tempo-43-2026'). Part of the novelty key alongside type+from+to (coopjednota-specific 4-part key) - regional leaflets can share type and dates.

terminate.description: Stop an in-progress fetch/parse and exit cleanly.
